readiness_metadata.title: Final Evaluation Readiness Checklist & Protocol Resolution

onnx_models.limitation: ONNX graphs (e.g. react_pp_yolo12m.onnx) have a fixed monolithic input [1, 3, 640, 640] and bake detector NMS into graph; no input nodes exist for ground-truth boxes or labels.

pytorch_models.condition: Supported via GeneralizedYOLO when cfg.model.roi_relation_head.use_gt_box=True and use_gt_object_label=True.
pytorch_models.limitation: Cross-dataset PredCls requires object class index remapping because model object embeddings are sized to native dataset vocabularies (e.g. PSG 134 vs VG150 151 classes).

cross_dataset_validity.sgdet_cross_dataset: UNSUPPORTED (Disjoint object vocabularies: VG150 150 classes, PSG 133, IndoorVG 84, OpenImages 75)
cross_dataset_validity.predcls_cross_dataset: SUPPORTED only if ground-truth object labels are mapped to the evaluated model's embedding vocabulary or evaluated in class-agnostic predicate mode.

prerequisite_2_ontology_projection.policy: Never map prediction indices assuming identity mapping (index i != dataset ID i). Use dataset-specific lookup from evaluation_ontology.json to canonical predicate name, then map to 1-indexed view ontology ID.
prerequisite_2_ontology_projection.directionality: 100% endpoint preserved. Open Images inside_of -> in (contained->container), contain -> has (container->content). Redundant unmapped predictions filtered without endpoint reversal.

prerequisite_3_empty_images_policy.primary_metric: Eligible images only (filter_empty_gt=True). Recall@K is averaged strictly over images containing at least one ground-truth relationship in the evaluated vocabulary view.
prerequisite_3_empty_images_policy.secondary_metric: All 200 images penalized (filter_empty_gt=False). Images with 0 GT relations receive Recall=0.0 and are included in the 200-image denominator.

prerequisite_4_duplicate_triplets_policy.ground_truth_matching: Standard union matching (reduce(np.union1d, pred_to_gt[:k])). A single prediction matching multiple identical ground-truth triplets marks those triplets as covered. Denominator is total ground-truth instances.
prerequisite_4_duplicate_triplets_policy.prediction_deduplication: Evaluate under standard Graph Constraint (top-1 relation per pair) and No Graph Constraint (multiple relations per pair allowed; duplicate identical triplets waste top-k budget).

recall_and_mean_recall.mean_recall_rule: Classes with 0 ground-truth instances in the evaluated subset are excluded from the macro-average denominator, preventing artificial deflation.

latency_and_memory.rules: 10 warmup runs, batch size 1, CUDA event timing with torch.cuda.synchronize(), peak RSS memory via resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss.

data_familiarity_disclosures.indoorvg_leakage: 100% of IndoorVG_200 images (200/200) exist in VG150 training set. Models trained on VG150 must be labeled as 'Prior Training Exposure' when evaluated on IndoorVG_200.
data_familiarity_disclosures.native_vs_cross: Disclosed across all tables: Native (trained on dataset), Familiar/Overlapping (VG150 on IndoorVG), Cross-Dataset (unseen distribution).

required_code_modifications.modification_needed: Add prediction ontology projection function that maps raw model predicted predicate labels into normalized evaluation IDs (1..6, 1..8, 1..20) using evaluation_ontology.json.
Add --task argument (predcls, sgcls, sgdet) to support PredCls evaluation for PyTorch checkpoints (currently hardcoded to forward(img_list) without targets).
Support dynamic num_rel_category matching the normalized evaluation view (6, 8, 20) instead of relying strictly on cfg.model.roi_relation_head.num_classes.
Add support for filter_empty_gt flag to optionally exclude images with len(gt_rels) == 0 from the Recall@K average denominator.
